zh-Hans: 唯独不能留下遗憾，赌上本地最快的骄傲也要拼到底！
en: I won't leave any regrets. Not with our pride as the fastest on our home course at stake!

zh-Hans: 只能豁出去了。
en: All I can do is go for it.

zh-Hans: 被超了！
en: He passed us!

zh-Hans: 糟了！
en: I blew it!

zh-Hans: 怎么会……
en: No way...

zh-Hans: 呜！
en: Ugh!

zh-Hans: 被超了！
en: We're being passed!

zh-Hans: 怎么会这么快？
en: How can he be so fast?

zh-Hans: 被咬住了，为什么？沙雪，我的状态不够好吗？
en: He's right on us. Why? Am I off my game, Sayuki?

zh-Hans: 这次一定要漂亮地拿下！
en: I'll nail this!

zh-Hans: 我绝不能输！
en: I can't afford to lose!

zh-Hans: 就在这里决胜负！
en: I'll settle it here!

zh-Hans: 感觉不错！
en: This feels good!

zh-Hans: 根本不是对手呢。
en: He's no match for us.

zh-Hans: 好，沙雪。让他见识我有史以来最好的表现！
en: Okay, Sayuki. I'll give him the best run of my life!

zh-Hans: 比传闻中还厉害呢，真子。
en: He's even better than they say, Mako.

zh-Hans: 留五厘米，路边沙子多！
en: Leave five centimeters. There's a lot of sand!

zh-Hans: 现在才刚开始呢！
en: We're just getting started!

zh-Hans: 真子的实力可不止这样！
en: Mako's got a lot more in her than this!

zh-Hans: 尽情享受吧，这场较量多过瘾！
en: Enjoy it! This is one hell of a battle!

zh-Hans: 我们一定会攻到底！
en: We'll push it all the way!

zh-Hans: 他修正到理想路线，直接穿过去了！
en: He corrected onto the perfect line and shot through!

zh-Hans: 怎么可能！
en: That's impossible!

zh-Hans: 可恶！
en: Ugh!

zh-Hans: 被摆了一道！
en: He got us!

zh-Hans: 他还游刃有余，真让人不甘心！
en: He's got so much left in reserve. It's infuriating!

zh-Hans: 凭现在的我们，还对付不了他。
en: He's more than we can handle right now.

zh-Hans: 赢不了！竟然选了这种远超想象的怪物当对手！
en: We can't win! We've picked a monster who's in a whole different league!

zh-Hans: 相信自己的技术，只管往前冲！
en: Trust your skills and keep pushing!

zh-Hans: 看他还能跟到什么时候！
en: Let's see how long he can keep up!

zh-Hans: 果然不是普通车手，竟然咬住了！
en: He's no ordinary racer. He's staying with us!

zh-Hans: 后面的动静我都盯着呢！
en: I've got a close eye on everything behind us!

zh-Hans: 真子，你状态很好！别再看后视镜了，会乱了节奏的。
en: You're driving well, Mako! Stop checking the mirror. It'll throw off your rhythm.

zh-Hans: 胆子不小啊，竟敢跟着真子这样冲进弯！
en: He's got guts, following Mako into the corners like that!

zh-Hans: 漂亮！对，真子，就是这种感觉！
en: Nice! That's it, Mako! Just like that!

zh-Hans: 漂亮！
en: Nice!

zh-Hans: 对，真子，就是这种感觉！
en: That's it, Mako! Just like that!

zh-Hans: 我们认真起来，可远不止这点本事！
en: We're capable of a lot more when we get serious!

zh-Hans: 一口气冲过去！
en: Let's go for it!

zh-Hans: 论漂移，当然是碓冰的车手最强！
en: Nobody drifts better than the racers of Usui!

zh-Hans: 就这样一口气冲到终点！
en: Keep going, all the way to the finish!

zh-Hans: 碓冰最快的名号，可不能让出去！
en: We're not giving up our title as the fastest on Usui!

zh-Hans: 下一个弯抓地过。
en: Take the next one with grip.

zh-Hans: 下一个弯可以滑过去！
en: You can slide through the next one!

zh-Hans: 贴紧内线，抓地过弯！
en: Hug the inside and grip through!

zh-Hans: 能行！
en: You can do it!

zh-Hans: 漂亮，真子！
en: Nice one, Mako!

zh-Hans: 我们这对搭档，跑碓冰可是比谁都快！
en: No one gets through Usui faster than the two of us!

zh-Hans: 状态绝佳，完全跑开了！
en: You're absolutely on fire!

zh-Hans: 厉害！真子，你状态这么好，谁来都赢不了你！
en: Amazing, Mako! The way you're driving, no one can beat you!

zh-Hans: 太厉害了，厉害得都有点吓人！
en: Incredible! You're almost scary!

zh-Hans: 真子，你现在跑得比我见过的任何时候都好！
en: Mako, this is the best I've ever seen you drive!

zh-Hans: 好了，真子，要上了！
en: All right, Mako! Let's go!

zh-Hans: 有弯就先攻进去，这才是车手的本能吧！
en: If there's a corner, you attack it. That's a racer's instinct!
